svg.text: Wide layout: see each responsibility clearly and follow data movement without crowded connectors.

#CI-CD
GitHub Actions
Ruff • mypy • pytest • security • Docker build

COLOR / HASHTAG LEGEND
🔵 #API / #Router = HTTP entry points
🟢 #Service = business rules
🟡 #Repository = database access
🟩 #Database = persistent data
🟧 #Cache / #Broker = fast temporary data / queue
🟥 #Async = background processing
🟣 #Observability / #E2E-Test = testing + monitoring
⚪ #External-Service / #Storage = outside dependencies
